tokens.name: smalt-900
tokens.usage: Royal grade. Deepest brand fill; pressed states on smalt-700.

tokens.name: smalt-700
tokens.usage: Smalt itself (#003399). The brand colour: logo body, primary actions in light theme. 10.9:1 with white.

tokens.name: smalt-500
tokens.usage: Medium grade. Secondary brand fill, charts. Not for body text on dark grounds.

tokens.name: smalt-300
tokens.usage: Fine grade. The chip in the Grain mark; decorative fills. Fill only on light grounds: 2.9:1 on white and 2.7:1 on bg, under the 3:1 guide for graphics, so never the only way to show something (fine in the logo).

tokens.name: smalt-200
tokens.usage: Pale smalt. Primary, link and logo body in dark theme (8.8:1 on bg).

tokens.name: smalt-100
tokens.usage: Flour grade. Tints, selected rows, the chip on dark.

tokens.name: kiln-500
tokens.usage: Kiln orange as a FILL only (3.4:1 on white, 3.2:1 on bg): commit markers, highlights, and the second piece of the smaltworks Together mark (#FF8A5C on dark). Never text on light grounds.

tokens.name: layer-language
tokens.usage: The language layer's colour (cobalt magenta): smaltql, smaltdf and smaltts take it for their mark's chip and fills. 5.4:1 on bg / 5.8:1 on surface light; 7.7:1 / 7.1:1 dark. Use layer-language-text for text.

tokens.name: layer-language-text
tokens.usage: The language layer's colour as text, e.g. the 'ql', 'df' and 'ts' in the wordmarks. 6.8:1 on bg / 7.3:1 on surface light; 7.7:1 / 7.1:1 dark.

tokens.name: layer-kit
tokens.usage: The kit layer's colour (jade): smaltml takes it. 4.7:1 on bg / 5.1:1 on surface light; 8.1:1 / 7.4:1 dark. CIELAB distance 27 from success: never use it to mean success. Use layer-kit-text for text.

tokens.name: layer-kit-text
tokens.usage: The kit layer's colour as text. 6.0:1 on bg / 6.4:1 on surface light; 8.1:1 / 7.4:1 dark.

tokens.name: layer-tool
tokens.usage: The user-tool layer's colour (deep cerulean): smaltui, smaltbi, smaltnb and smaltfl. 4.2:1 on bg / 4.5:1 on surface light; 8.4:1 / 7.8:1 dark. Use layer-tool-text for text.

tokens.name: layer-tool-text
tokens.usage: The user-tool layer's colour as text. 5.6:1 on bg / 6.0:1 on surface light; 8.4:1 / 7.8:1 dark.

tokens.name: layer-ai
tokens.usage: smaltai's colour (blue-leaning violet); smaltai runs alongside the layers. 5.6:1 on bg / 6.1:1 on surface light; 8.0:1 / 7.4:1 dark. It sits close to smalt (CIELAB distance 21), which is why it marks smaltai, which doesn't touch the engine, rather than a layer that sits on it. Use layer-ai-text for text.

tokens.name: layer-ai-text
tokens.usage: smaltai's colour as text. 6.8:1 on bg / 7.3:1 on surface light; 8.0:1 / 7.4:1 dark.

tokens.name: product-ui
tokens.usage: smaltui's colour: the tool layer's. An alias of layer-tool, kept so existing uses keep working.

tokens.name: product-ui-text
tokens.usage: smaltui's colour as text: an alias of layer-tool-text.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, inputs on bg.

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Code blocks and inline code. Every syn-* token is >= 5.3:1 on it.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines and card outlines. Decorative; controls also need text or focus contrast.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body and headings. 16.3:1 light / 15.0:1 dark on bg.

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text, descriptions. >= 8.7:1 on bg and surface (AAA).

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Captions, metadata, placeholders. >= 5.5:1 on bg and surface.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary buttons and key actions.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text on primary. 10.9:1 light / 8.8:1 dark.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links, always underlined in body copy. 10.0:1 light / 8.8:1 dark on bg.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Kiln orange as TEXT: commit/write emphasis. 6.1:1 light / 7.7:1 dark on bg.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, 2px offset. 10.0:1 light / 7.7:1 dark on bg.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Committed / ok. Always with a check icon and a word.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Stale / needs refresh. Always with a triangle icon and a word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed / destructive. Crimson, kept apart from kiln orange. Always with an x icon and a word.

tokens.name: syn-keyword
tokens.usage: Code keywords. 9.6:1 light / 9.0:1 dark on code-bg.

tokens.name: syn-string
tokens.usage: Code strings, incl. SQL text. 5.9:1 / 7.9:1 on code-bg.

tokens.name: syn-number
tokens.usage: Code numbers and literals. 6.8:1 / 9.4:1 on code-bg.

tokens.name: syn-function
tokens.usage: Function and method names. 6.1:1 / 10.7:1 on code-bg.

tokens.name: syn-comment
tokens.usage: Comments, italic. 5.3:1 / 6.2:1 on code-bg.

tokens.name: syn-punct
tokens.usage: Punctuation and operators. 8.4:1 / 9.9:1 on code-bg.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Queries run in a Web Worker, so the page stays responsive.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, breadcrumbs, nav labels. Short strings only, never paragraphs.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps between related controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding (small).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, default gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section gaps inside a card.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section spacing on pages.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page gutters on wide screens.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inline code, chips, grain-sized details.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, code blocks.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, app icon corners at small sizes.
